heroHeadline: Bad Bunny's Hiram Bithorn Homecoming Shows Sell Out in Under 6 Hours
heroSubtitle: Tickets for Bad Bunny's two "Debí Tirar Más Fotos – Cerramos en Casa" closing shows at Estadio Hiram Bithorn (Aug 22–23) sold out completely within six hours of the August 19 on-sale, with over 1 million users joining the virtual queue via PRticket.com. Separately, MTV nominated Bad Bunny for a 2026 Video Music Award — Best Latin, for "NUEVAYoL" — with the ceremony airing September 27. The homecoming shows cap the record-breaking, $467.5 million-grossing Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour in the country where it launched via the sold-out Coliseo residency.
